reviewer: independent reviewer; did not build or edit R3

criteria.name: Identity and footprint
findings: Official 2023 Indiana orthophoto and GIS FID 857 match the multi-wing complex outline at campus scale.
FID 108 is a distinct compact southeast mass; touching/overlapping polygons and approximate campus projection do not establish every wall-level boundary.

criteria.name: Placement and orientation
findings: Read-only master inspection found one collection instance and resolving relative source path.
Marker location (66.300003, 86.5, 0) m agrees with manifest (66.300001, 86.5) within approximately 0.000002 m; rotation zero and scale one.
The campus transform remains approximate, not survey control.

criteria.name: Form, height, and roof
findings: R3 adds an official 2023 orthophoto registered across all 102 upward FID 857 roof faces, materially improving visible roof plan/color fidelity.
This texture does not establish roof geometry, height, or slopes; the single 18.5 m FID 857 shell and 18.5–18.75 m cap remain unverified against wing-specific roof datums.

criteria.name: Facade, materials, and entrance
findings: Qualitative support remains for brick, dark glazing, frames, stone bands, and the fountain-facing arch.
R3 did not change facade geometry; the repeated four-course schedule and entrance along-wall position are not registered to a GIS edge.

criteria.name: Interior and circulation
findings: Evacuation and renovation sources support broad core/connection context but are not scale-registered current floor plans.
Current partitions, complete circulation, and Gatewood connection remain schematic or unverified.

criteria.name: Technical integrity
findings: Blender 5.2.3 reopen and R3 validation pass; the orthophoto is packed and no external image dependency remains.
Read-only master check confirms the linked collection and marker path resolve.
Manifest object_count and object list are stale at 50 while the current source collection has 55; coordinator should reconcile the shared index during integration.

decision: Pass at 8.0/10. R3 materially improves the major roof surface with registered 2023 orthophoto, and the master placement/path are independently verified. Structural roof form/height, registered facade detail, and current interior remain unverified; manifest inventory needs coordinator update from 50 to 55 objects.
